Sunday 11/ 15

May The Brunch Be Ever In Your Favor

11:00 AM - 2:00 PM More Deets

Hunger Games Drag Brunch! Get Tickets Here.

It’s brunch with all the glamour of the Capitol and the realness of District 12. Our Queens are firing off moves with Katniss level precision and serving face fresher than a loaf of Peeta’s bread. Doors open at 11:00am and show starts at 12:00pm. Be sure to bring plenty of ones to tip your queens and check out the additional details below!

Please note that tickets for this event are sold by the table. As a result all seats at a table must be purchased at once. For example, purchasing a four top table will require the purchase of four tickets. Tickets come with access to the show only. All food and beverage is pay as you go upon entry. This event is 18+, please be sure to bring valid ID. This event will operate at capacity, as such there is no guarantee that if you purchase more than one table that they will be next to one another. It is also possible that you will be asked to share your table with other guests if needed. For any questions related to this event please email info@evilgeniusbeer.com.

*Refund Policy: All ticket sales are final. To keep our events running smoothly and ensure our staff is appropriately prepared, all tickets are non-refundable. If you have questions about this policy or about your ticket please reach out to info@evilgeniusbeer.com

Saturday 11/ 21

The Lydia Blair Band – Live at Evil Genius

8:00 PM - 11:00 PM More Deets

Lydia Blair is a songwriter and performer with melodies that punch you in the gut. Her introspective uptempo pop features lush production and stacked vocals – you will dance, you will cry, you will groove. Her live show fuses the polished pop production of the early aughts with real instruments. Think high drama, high energy, harmonies, coordinated outfits, and live samples.Her 5-piece band brings their energetic set to venues in the greater Philadelphia area.
